brief: Prepare the requirement for a fictional workshop opening. The chosen record must describe the need, not prematurely choose a supplier.

fields.explanation: Camera cases cannot replace the electronics kits learners will use; copying the offer would leave the workshop without its required equipment.

fields.explanation: Ten kits would leave two of the twelve learners without equipment. Keep one kit per learner.
fields.label: Required quantity

fields.explanation: An arrival on 16 October misses the 14 October workshop. The brief needs kits by 12 October for preparation.
fields.label: Required arrival

fields.explanation: Choosing the lowest displayed price would omit required cases. Record scope, date and budget so the next owner can understand the award.
